# Copilot project instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `docs/conversion-guide.md` before a conversion. Read
`docs/java-architecture.md` before generating or modifying Java code.

Use English for all new content and communication. Preserve supplied source files.
Establish the user's full or partial conversion scope in each new session before
generating business code; do not repeat a question already answered in that session.
Store the analysis, decisions, generated application, and verification evidence in
an isolated conversion directory. Do not treat the Spring Boot starter as a
completed conversion. Run the project's Maven Wrapper verification before delivery.
